meta.name: review-animations
meta.description: Reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar derived from Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy. Default to flagging; approval is earned.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审动效代码,把不够讲究的细节逐条挑出来改到位
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在意界面动效的手感,想有人按高标准帮你挑毛病
copy.tagline_en: Review motion code and flag every detail that falls short of a high craft bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you care about motion feel and want a strict eye on your animation code

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会专门审查动画与动效代码,按 Emil Kowalski 的高标准逐条挑问题,产出 Before/After/Why 表格和分级结论,最后给出 Block 或 Approve 的判定。
howto.when: 当你明确要求评审动画或动效代码时触发(该技能不自动调用)。它只做动效评审;若让它审普通代码,会拒绝并指向通用评审技能。

say.text: 帮我审查这段动画代码
say.note: 首次会先说一句准备就绪,等你提问

say.text: 这个下拉菜单的动效有问题吗?
这个 toast 的过渡该怎么改?
say.note: 会按修复优先级给出具体改法

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reviews animation and motion code against a high craft bar from Emil Kowalski's philosophy, flags issues, and returns a Before/After/Why table plus a tiered verdict ending in Block or Approve.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you explicitly ask it to review animation or motion code (model invocation is disabled). It declines general code review and points to a general review skill.

say_en.text: Review this animation code for me
say_en.note: It first says it is ready, then waits for your question

say_en.text: Is the motion on this dropdown any good?
say_en.note: You get a Before/After table and a Block/Approve verdict

say_en.text: How should this toast transition be changed?
say_en.note: It proposes fixes in its remedial priority order
